title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: tier dues billing and membership discount basis
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's tier basis for billing the employer's master account and for the discount that billing bundles onto the enrolled employee's own club membership dues.

Under this policy's original basis, each billing cycle the employer's master account was billed the enrollment's tier recurring per-employee dues rate for the enrolled employee. That clause is no longer in force: the current basis for what is billed to the employer's master account each billing cycle — including any one-time charge added on a first cycle — is stated in a separate document, and the recurring per-employee dues rate itself remains the tier value stated in the dues-rate reference for this product.

The membership-discount clause of this policy remains in force: the enrolled employee's bundled club membership dues receive the tier's employer-sponsored discount off, capped at the tier's combined discount cap where the tier allows that discount to stack with another membership promotion. Where stacking is not allowed for the tier, the employer-sponsored discount applies on its own without that combined cap coming into play.

superseded_clauses: Each billing cycle the employer's master account is billed monthly_dues_per_employee_usd for the enrolled employee
